meta: Write English emails to your boss or foreign clients with AI: word-for-word translations sound stiff, and AI helps you get the right office tone.

muc.title: Emails that sound stiff
muc.text: English emails translated word for word often sound stiff. AI helps you write in the right office tone.

muc.title: Type your points in Vietnamese
muc.text: Type the main points in Vietnamese, say whether it's for your boss or a client, and whether you want it formal or friendly.

muc.title: Ask why it chose those lines
muc.text: Ask AI why it chose that opening and closing, so next time you can write them yourself.

muc.title: Remove company data
muc.text: Before pasting, remove client names, contract prices and company data, and replace them with general words.

muc.title: Asking to move a meeting
muc.text: Ask AI to write an English email asking to move a meeting, in a formal and a friendly version.
